title: Heat illness buddy check for outdoor work
summary: A buddy-check routine for cleanup, farming, queue management, animal care, or foot evacuation during heat when people may ignore early illness signs.
content: Core sequence: 1) Pair workers before starting and require each pair to check speech, balance, sweating, confusion, and water breaks. 2) Move heavy tasks to cooler hours and keep shade breaks scheduled, not optional. 3) Stop work for confusion, fainting, severe weakness, hot skin, vomiting, or behavior that does not fit the person. 4) Cool the person and seek urgent medical help when serious heat-illness signs appear.
